name: T Cha

paper.title: New constraints on the disk characteristics and companion candidates around T Cha with VLT/SPHERE

notes: Transition disk with a large gap (~30 au); highly inclined (~69 deg) with east-west scattered-light asymmetry. A point source at 3.5" from the star (Pohl et al. 2017) was found NOT to be co-moving, ruling it out as a bound companion; no companion candidate with mass >~8.5 Mjup found between 0.1-0.3".
